concerns.text: FR-002 mandates extraction of 'tail decay exponent' via MLE. The plan replaces this with 'Spectral Entropy' and tasks T013 implement Entropy. No task exists to implement the 'tail decay exponent' calculation required by the spec, leaving FR-002 unimplemented.

FR-004 mandates training a 'lightweight classification model' (Logistic Regression/RF/MLP). The plan rejects classification for N<20 and substitutes Spearman Correlation. Tasks T026/T027 implement correlation analysis. No task exists to implement the classification model required by FR-004.

SC-001 requires measuring 'Prediction accuracy... baseline + 5%'. The plan and tasks implement Spearman correlation (outputting rho), not classification accuracy. No task exists to calculate or report the accuracy metric defined in SC-001.

SC-005 requires measuring the final count of diverse architectures (min 20) and distribution constraints. Task T012b only logs/excludes if <20 but does not implement a verification step to measure and report the final count/distribution against the SC-005 threshold as a pass/fail criterion.

Task T012b references 'FR-001 compliance' regarding the 20-model count. However, FR-001 is about computing the covariance matrix, while the 20-model diversity constraint is actually defined in SC-005. The tag/reference is slightly misaligned with the specific requirement ID.
